comment:
* Settings describe characteristics of the sending peer, which are used by the receiving peer.
 * Settings are {@link FramedConnection connection} scoped.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: DEFAULT_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE
variables.comment:
* From the SPDY/3 and HTTP/2 specs, the default initial window size for all
   * streams is 64 KiB. (Chrome 25 uses 10 MiB).

variables.name: FLAG_CLEAR_PREVIOUSLY_PERSISTED_SETTINGS
variables.comment: Peer request to clear durable settings.

variables.name: PERSIST_VALUE
variables.comment: Sent by servers only. The peer requests this setting persisted for future connections.

variables.name: PERSISTED
variables.comment: Sent by clients only. The client is reminding the server of a persisted value.

variables.name: UPLOAD_BANDWIDTH
variables.comment: spdy/3: Sender's estimate of max incoming kbps.

variables.name: HEADER_TABLE_SIZE
variables.comment: HTTP/2: Size in bytes of the table used to decode the sender's header blocks.

variables.name: DOWNLOAD_BANDWIDTH
variables.comment: spdy/3: Sender's estimate of max outgoing kbps.

variables.name: ENABLE_PUSH
variables.comment: HTTP/2: The peer must not send a PUSH_PROMISE frame when this is 0.

variables.name: ROUND_TRIP_TIME
variables.comment: spdy/3: Sender's estimate of millis between sending a request and receiving a response.

variables.name: MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS
variables.comment: Sender's maximum number of concurrent streams.

variables.name: CURRENT_CWND
variables.comment: spdy/3: Current CWND in Packets.

variables.name: MAX_FRAME_SIZE
variables.comment: HTTP/2: Size in bytes of the largest frame payload the sender will accept.

variables.name: DOWNLOAD_RETRANS_RATE
variables.comment: spdy/3: Retransmission rate. Percentage

variables.name: MAX_HEADER_LIST_SIZE
variables.comment: HTTP/2: Advisory only. Size in bytes of the largest header list the sender will accept.

variables.name: INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE
variables.comment: Window size in bytes.

variables.name: CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_VECTOR_SIZE
variables.comment: spdy/3: Size of the client certificate vector. Unsupported.

variables.name: FLOW_CONTROL_OPTIONS
variables.comment: Flow control options.

variables.name: COUNT
variables.comment: Total number of settings.

variables.name: FLOW_CONTROL_OPTIONS_DISABLED
variables.comment: If set, flow control is disabled for streams directed to the sender of these settings.

variables.name: set
variables.comment: Bitfield of which flags that values.

variables.name: persistValue
variables.comment: Bitfield of flags that have {@link #PERSIST_VALUE}.

variables.name: persisted
variables.comment: Bitfield of flags that have {@link #PERSISTED}.

variables.name: values
variables.comment: Flag values.

methods.name: Settings set(int id, int idFlags, int value)
boolean isSet(int id)
methods.comment: Returns true if a value has been assigned for the setting {@code id}.

methods.name: int get(int id)
methods.comment: Returns the value for the setting {@code id}, or 0 if unset.

methods.name: int flags(int id)
methods.comment: Returns the flags for the setting {@code id}, or 0 if unset.

methods.name: int size()
methods.comment: Returns the number of settings that have values assigned.

methods.name: boolean getEnablePush(boolean defaultValue)
methods.comment: TODO: honor this setting in HTTP/2.

methods.name: int getMaxConcurrentStreams(int defaultValue)
methods.comment: TODO: honor this setting in spdy/3 and HTTP/2.

methods.name: boolean isFlowControlDisabled()
methods.comment: TODO: honor this setting in spdy/3 and HTTP/2.

methods.name: boolean persistValue(int id)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if this user agent should use this setting in future spdy/3
   * connections to the same host.

methods.name: boolean isPersisted(int id)
methods.comment: Returns true if this setting was persisted.

methods.name: void merge(Settings other)
methods.comment:
* Writes {@code other} into this. If any setting is populated by this and
   * {@code other}, the value and flags from {@code other} will be kept.

methodNames: Settings set(int id, int idFlags, int value)
